sources.title: ESPEN practical guideline: Clinical Nutrition in cancer
sources.authors: Maurizio Muscaritoli, Jann Arends, Patrick Bachmann, and colleagues
sources.supports: Screening, adult energy/protein estimates, nutrition route, micronutrients, and avoidance of energy-restrictive diets in malnutrition.

sources.title: Management of Cancer Cachexia: ASCO Guideline
sources.authors: Eric J. Roeland, Kari Bohlke, Vickie E. Baracos, and colleagues
sources.supports: Dietitian counseling and avoidance of routine tube feeding or PN for advanced-cancer cachexia alone; selected exceptions.

sources.title: Cancer Cachexia: ASCO Guideline Rapid Recommendation Update
sources.authors: Eric J. Roeland, Kari Bohlke, Vickie E. Baracos, Thomas J. Smith, and Charles L. Loprinzi
sources.read_level: Indexed updated recommendations 2.1-2.2 and qualifying statement
sources.supports: Selected low-dose olanzapine use for appetite/weight; prevents repeating an outdated blanket claim that no drug is supported.

sources.title: Nutrition support for adults: oral nutrition support, enteral tube feeding and parenteral nutrition (CG32)
sources.authors: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
sources.read_level: Indexed full recommendations 1.4.6-1.4.8; official PDF also identified
sources.supports: High refeeding-risk identification, cautious feeding, thiamine, electrolyte and fluid monitoring.

sources.title: Exercise, Diet, and Weight Management During Cancer Treatment: ASCO Guideline
sources.authors: Jennifer A. Ligibel, Kari Bohlke, Anne M. May, and colleagues
sources.supports: No routine neutropenic diet to prevent infection; limited evidence for specific diets/weight-loss interventions during treatment; exercise guidance.

sources.title: Cancer Therapy Interactions With Foods and Dietary Supplements (PDQ) - Health Professional Version
sources.authors: National Cancer Institute PDQ Integrative, Alternative, and Complementary Therapies Editorial Board
sources.year_note: Living evidence summary, snapshot accessed in 2026; not an original publication year
sources.read_level: Relevant full-text supplement and antioxidant sections
sources.supports: Supplement-drug interactions and uncertainty about antioxidant supplement safety/efficacy during treatment.

sources.title: Pancreatic cancer in adults: diagnosis and management (NG85)
sources.authors: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
sources.supports: Enteric-coated pancreatin in unresectable pancreatic cancer and perioperative nutrition route.

sources.title: Nutrition in Cancer Care (PDQ) - Health Professional Version
sources.authors: National Cancer Institute PDQ Supportive and Palliative Care Editorial Board
sources.year_note: Living evidence summary, snapshot accessed in 2026; not an original publication year
sources.read_level: Relevant full-text symptom and foodborne-illness sections
sources.supports: Nutrition-impact symptom management and food-safety counseling; evidence limitations of neutropenic diets.

sources.title: Cancer cachexia in adult patients: ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines
sources.authors: Jann Arends, Florian Strasser, Sandrine Gonella, and colleagues
sources.read_level: Relevant full-text nutrition, prognosis, and end-of-life sections
sources.supports: Multifactorial cachexia and benefit/burden-based decisions about nutrition support in advanced disease.
